mapper.select: /* Baim06Mapper.selectSiteNodeList */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , A.NODE_NM AS nodeNm , A.NODE_TYPE AS nodeType , A.PARENT_NODE_CD AS parentNodeCd , A.SELF_ATTD_APPRV_YN AS selfAttdApprvYn , A.MAIN_ADMIN_CD AS mainAdminCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MAIN_ADMIN_CD, NULL) AS mainAdminNm , A.SUB_ADMIN_CD AS subAdminCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.SUB_ADMIN_CD, NULL) AS subAdminNm , SUM(CASE WHEN B.USER_TYPE = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS managerCnt , SUM(CASE WHEN B.USER_TYPE = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS workerCnt FROM TB_SITE_NODE A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.USER_ID , A.SITE_CD , A.NODE_CD , CASE WHEN A.AUTH_CD = '99999' -- 일반사용자 기본 코드 THEN 'W' -- worker ELSE 'M' -- manager END USER_TYPE FROM TB_USER A INNER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.AUTH_CD = B.BAIM_VAL_D_CD AND B.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM005' AND (B.VAL_D_INFO_1 != 'manage' OR B.VAL_D_INFO_1 IS NULL) ) ) B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD AND A.NODE_CD = B.NODE_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} GROUP BY A.CMPNY_CD , A.SITE_CD , A.NODE_CD , A.NODE_NM , A.NODE_TYPE , A.PARENT_NODE_CD , A.SELF_ATTD_APPRV_YN
mapper.insert: /* Baim06Mapper.copySiteNode */ INSERT INTO TB_SITE_NODE ( CMPNY_CD , SITE_CD , NODE_CD , NODE_NM , NODE_TYPE , PARENT_NODE_CD , SELF_ATTD_APPRV_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT CMPNY_CD , #{siteCd} , NODE_CD , NODE_NM , NODE_TYPE , PARENT_NODE_CD , SELF_ATTD_APPRV_YN , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() FROM TB_SITE_NODE WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} AND NODE_CD != 'n1'
